description: This plot illustrates the relationship between accuracy and s_pop frequency. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with numeric tick marks placed at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains two lines, both featuring vertical error bars at each data point. The first line is dashed and blue, utilizing circular markers with black outlines. It begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.71 at an x-value of 1, rises to roughly 0.92 at x=3, and reaches 1.0 at x=9 and x=11; it then experiences a decline to approximately 0.9 at x=13 before returning to and maintaining a value of 1.0 from x=15 through the end of the axis at x=19. The second line is solid and green, utilizing square markers with black outlines. This line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.36 at x=1, steadily increases to a local peak of roughly 0.68 at x=7, and then sharply declines to approximately 0.45 at x=9. It rises again to about 0.65 at x=11, gradually decreases to roughly 0.48 at x=15, and finally exhibits a sharp increase to reach 1.0 at x=17, remaining at 1.0 at the final x-value of 19.
